scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.emulators: npm run build:all && firebase emulators:start --project demo-glengarry-clg
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:all && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-glengarry-clg --only auth,firestore,storage,functions 'node --test tests/integration.test.mjs'
scripts.format: prettier --write src functions/src functions/scripts scripts tests
